svg.title: Space probe separating in flight
svg.desc: With no air resistance, gravity bends the trajectory downward. Before separation the probe center of mass lies on the parabola. After separation, two equal-mass fragments lie on opposite sides of their combined center of mass, which continues on the same parabola. Total horizontal momentum remains constant; vertical momentum changes under the downward external force −Mg, with y positive upward. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Fragments separate; their center of mass keeps its trajectory
